responsibility: Render one production memory as a Focus surface with single-column primary content, grouped metadata, on-demand translation, honest mutation availability, deletion confirmation, and grounded creation navigation without claiming unsupported Core writes

inputs.memory: MemoryDetailModel mapped from CanonicalMemory (content, sourceType, timestamp, locale, edit state, conflict state). sourceType supports photo / note / voice / video_frame / video_audio

outputs.visibleContent: Memory original text, translated text (toggleable), grouped metadata (source/time/location), citation anchors and available actions. Production media is resolved from the authorized local source adapter; unresolved/revoked/missing media shows an honest localized fallback. Bundled samples are Preview/test-only and prohibited as production evidence.
outputs.interactionTargets: translateToggle, editButton, deleteButton, conflictActionButtons, saveButton, citationAnchor, retryButton, mediaPlayPause
outputs.accessibilityTree: Content in reading order; grouped metadata; media preview with label; each citation anchor as separate element

systemContainer: NavigationStack (pushed from Search/Home) + ScrollView + Form sheet for edit + Alert for delete confirmation
